candidate.title: Smart-Seq / NanoCAGE
candidate.scope: The middle Smart-Seq / NanoCAGE row of the supplied Illumina poster crop, with the original Smart-Seq and nanoCAGE implementations clarified by their matched primary papers. Inventory: a descriptive mRNA/SMART cartoon; RNA labeled mRNA fragment with poly(A); MMLV first-strand synthesis with CCC and an oligo(dT)-linked adapter; an opposite-end adapter in the Second strand synthesis panel; PCR amplification; Purify; generic DNA endpoint. This is a grouped explanatory motif, not an assertion of identical complete protocols. The literal oligo(dT) route is retained, and two explicitly primary-supported NanoCAGE counterpart operations clarify the named member without inventing a drawn branch or pooling. Neighboring DP-Seq and Smart-Seq2 rows, cropped Quartz-Seq2 text, the LNA structural illustration at right, CAGEscan, DLAF and downstream unshown library-preparation alternatives are outside the extraction unit. No strand polarity, sequence, attachment, compartment or barcode is inferred from line color alone.
